races.paceDynamic: Thistle Cross will take them along as the sole confirmed front runner, but his tendency to fade in the finish means he's unlikely to sustain pressure late. The prominent runners Suspicious Mindz, Sunrush and Full Moon Tonight will sit close enough to pounce, while a large contingent of hold-up horses including Matilda Joslyngage, Coasting, and De Songbird will look to come from behind. With limited early pace and multiple closers, this sets up perfectly for horses that can produce a strong finishing kick from off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Thistle Cross sets an honest but not demanding gallop
scenarios.body: The large field of closers gets the perfect setup as Thistle Cross fades turning for home, allowing the best finisher to strike late. This pace scenario heavily favours the hold-up brigade who can unleash one run.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes more competitive with multiple horses tracking Thistle Cross
scenarios.body: Suspicious Mindz or Full Moon Tonight can position perfectly in behind the leaders and kick clear before the hold-up horses get organized. Their prominent style avoids the traffic that could hamper the back-markers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Newcomer Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If one of the unraced horses from the O'Brien or McCreery stables shows unexposed ability
scenarios.body: Kirkland Sioux or Make The Tide could have the class edge over this modest field despite their inexperience. The sustainable pace would suit a well-schooled newcomer with natural ability.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Special
scenarios.trigger: If Thistle Cross goes too slow and multiple horses challenge simultaneously
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where the horse with the best turn of foot wins regardless of position. This chaos scenario could throw up an unlikely winner from the lower-rated runners.

watchPoints.text: Thistle Cross could set too slow a pace early which would turn this into a cavalry charge finish
Watch for market support for the three unraced horses, particularly Kirkland Sioux from the O'Brien stable
Suspicious Mindz needs to settle better than recent runs where he's raced keenly in prominent positions
Several horses returning from long layoffs including Daring Heart and Trustmore may need the run
The large group of hold-up horses could cause traffic problems in the straight if they're all making runs simultaneously

races.paceDynamic: Faoladh will lead from the gates with Dynamic Force, Ohmali, and Proleek Prince sitting prominently behind. With only one confirmed front-runner in this large field, Faoladh can dictate comfortable fractions without early pressure. The massive field of hold-up horses will create a wall of traffic behind the pace-setters, making clean passage crucial in the straight. This moderate early pace followed by a cavalry charge finish strongly favours prominent runners who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will engulf the back-markers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Faoladh sets sustainable fractions and the prominent horses get first run
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows Dynamic Force and Ohmali to travel smoothly in the box seat before kicking clear. The hold-up brigade gets caught in traffic as 13 horses try to make late moves simultaneously.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Leader Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If Faoladh gets uncontested fractions and stays on strongly
scenarios.body: With apprentice Adam Browne-Souza able to dictate the tempo, Faoladh builds an unassailable lead entering the straight. The chasing pack's delayed challenge comes too late against the front-runner's momentum.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic-Free Closer Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If one hold-up horse finds clear passage while others get blocked
scenarios.body: Land Of The Giants or Bay Of Dreams gets a dream run wide of the pack while the majority struggle for racing room. Their superior turn of foot proves decisive once in the clear.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos Benefits Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If multiple fallers or severe interference disrupts the pace dynamic
scenarios.body: Early incidents or bunching creates gaps for a horse like Bucaneer's Spirit to slip through. The race develops into a stop-start affair where stamina trumps pure speed.

races.paceDynamic: Timeless Charm and Diamond Exchange will ensure this race gets off to a strong gallop, with both confirmed front runners unlikely to give each other an easy lead. Chica Guerrera and Great Mover sitting prominent will keep the pace honest through the middle stages, preventing any slow sectionals that could favor late closers. The combination of two natural leaders and solid pace pressure from those tracking means this will be run at a genuine clip throughout. This race shape strongly favors prominent racers and early tactical speed over pure hold-up horses who will face a difficult task coming from too far back.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Pace Pressure
scenarios.trigger: If both Timeless Charm and Diamond Exchange engage early and maintain strong fractions
scenarios.body: The honest gallop will stretch the field and expose the limitations of pure hold-up horses, allowing those with early tactical speed to capitalize. Prominent racers with finishing kick will benefit most from the strong foundation pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leaders gets an uncontested advantage while the other falters early
scenarios.body: Either Timeless Charm or Diamond Exchange could steal a march and prove difficult to peg back over this staying trip. The winner will need to have the stamina to sustain their effort from the front.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Revival
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace collapses with both leaders going too fast too soon
scenarios.body: The race could set up perfectly for the backmarkers to mount late challenges in a slowly-run affair. Horses with proven finishing kicks will benefit from conserved energy.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If tactical riding sees everyone wait and the pace becomes pedestrian throughout
scenarios.body: A sprint finish from the entire field would favor horses with the highest cruising speed regardless of normal running style. Class and recent form become paramount in a blanket finish.

watchPoints.text: Watch if both Timeless Charm and Diamond Exchange go too fast early as this could set up a collapse scenario favoring backmarkers
Monitor Star Mind's early position as recent winner with weight advantage could be overlooked despite apprentice jockey
Observe Summer Snow's settling with first-time tongue tie as top weight needs to conserve energy for finishing effort
Check Great Mover's tactical positioning as prominent style suits but lack of recent wins suggests vulnerability under pressure
Watch Inthesmallhours for market confidence as recent form winner with strong jockey booking could be underestimated

races.paceDynamic: Scandinavia, Dallas Star, and Mont St Michel will create a genuine gallop from the start, with Scandinavia likely to dominate early given her proven stamina and recent Group 1 form. The strong pace will stretch this small field and test stamina reserves over the extended 1m6f trip on good ground. Happy Pharoah may track the leaders while the two hold-up horses Le Destrier and Leinster will need the pace to collapse late. This race shape strongly favours proven stayers who can either sustain the gallop or have the class to quicken off it, disadvantaging horses returning from long breaks or those lacking stamina credentials.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Scandinavia Dominates Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Scandinavia dictates from the front and her class tells
scenarios.body: Her Group 1-winning form at this trip gives her the engine to maintain a strong gallop and kick clear when the pressure mounts. The lesser opposition lacks her proven stamina and quality to match her sustained effort.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Closer Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If the front-runners go too fast early and fade in the final furlong
scenarios.body: Le Destrier or Leinster can capitalize on their fresh legs and pick up the pieces as the pace collapses. The 691-day break for Le Destrier becomes an advantage if the race falls apart.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Duel Suits Tracker
scenarios.trigger: If Scandinavia and Dallas Star engage in a prolonged battle
scenarios.body: Happy Pharoah can sit behind the leaders and strike late when they've compromised each other. His prominent style allows him to capitalize on the pace without being part of the early burn.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Upset from Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If the small field and strong pace creates chaos in the final 2f
scenarios.body: Dallas Star or Mont St Michel could benefit from the mayhem despite their recent poor form. The reduced field dynamics might suit their front-running styles if others falter.

watchPoints.text: Scandinavia setting too slow a pace early would completely change the race dynamics and favour the hold-up horses.

Dallas Star and Mont St Michel engaging in an early speed duel which would compromise both front-runners.
Happy Pharoah's position turning for home as his prominent style makes him the key tactical pivot in the race.
The ground conditions holding up through the card as any deterioration would impact the hold-up horses most.

races.paceDynamic: Numidia will take this field along as the sole confirmed front runner, with Eastern Wind and Marians Gal likely to press from prominent positions early. The sustainable pace should allow the large contingent of hold-up horses to get into the race turning for home. With 16 of the 20 runners employing hold-up tactics, this creates a cavalry charge finish where positioning and a clear run will be crucial. This race shape strongly favours closers with tactical speed who can find gaps in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays reasonable and the field bunches turning in
scenarios.body: The wall of closers will engulf the leaders with Trishuli River and Maxwell Smart best placed to benefit from their recent form. Strong finishers with class will separate from the pack.

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Wins

scenarios.label: D

scenarios.body: A horse with fading tendencies finds the pace collapse suits them perfectly or an unconsidered runner gets a dream run through. Form lines get turned upside down.

races.paceDynamic: Poetic Sound will set a steady pace from the front with potential support from Touch The Moon, Autumn Twist, Soaring Sun and Nakasero in the prominent positions. The pace should be sustainable rather than searching, as there's no confirmed speed horse to apply serious early pressure. A large group of hold-up horses including Star Harbour, Jabbar, Drucker and The Real Screamer will be tracking from midfield and rear. This tactical setup clearly favours the hold-up horses who can capitalize on the steady gallop and time their challenges late in a 1m4f contest.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is steady as expected with Poetic Sound leading unopposed
scenarios.body: The prominent horses will lack the tactical speed to respond when the hold-up brigade unleashes their finishing kicks in the final 3f. Multiple closers will sweep past the early leaders who've done too much work.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners can secure ideal tracking position behind the leaders
scenarios.body: They'll have enough left to hold off the late challengers despite the tactical disadvantage. Touch The Moon or Autumn Twist are best placed to execute this scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Poetic Sound goes too slow early and prominent horses fail to take it up
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the 4f pole where tactical position matters less than raw finishing speed. This neutralizes the hold-up advantage and opens up the field.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Poetic Sound gets uncontested fractions and the field misjudges the pace
scenarios.body: The leader will have enough left to hold off late challenges in a race where the chasers leave their runs too late. Requires perfect tactical execution from Burns.

watchPoints.text: Poetic Sound may get uncontested lead - if allowed easy fractions the 94-rated mare could prove hard to peg back despite long absence
